author: Temminck & Schlegel, 1845
status: 텃새 수만 마리 · 겨울철새 수백 마리
summary: 한국 중·남부 이남에 사는 새로, 홀로 또는 암수가 함께 지낸다. 나뭇가지에 둥지를 틀고 4~7월에 알 6~7개를 낳는다. 국외에서는 사할린섬, 중국 북부, 일본에 분포한다.

points.ko: 검은 날개의 흰 반점, 날 때 뚜렷
points.en: white patch on black wings, striking in flight
white throat and underparts with pale rufous flanks

sexes.male: 머리는 갈색, 등은 회색이고 눈줄과 날개깃이 검으며 날개에 흰 반점이 있다. 멱과 가슴, 배는 희고 옆구리는 연한 적갈색이다.
sexes.female: 머리는 갈색, 눈줄과 등은 진한 갈색이며 눈줄이 수컷보다 좁다. 가슴과 배는 연한 적갈색에 촘촘한 비늘무늬가 있고 날개에 흰 점이 없다.

art.subject: Bull-headed Shrike (Lanius bucephalus), adult male, as seen in central and southern Korea in spring: crown and nape bright rufous-chestnut; narrow whitish supercilium; broad black mask from the lores through the eye to the ear coverts; mantle, back and rump blue-grey; wings black with a white patch at the base of the primaries; tail long and graduated, dark grey-brown becoming blacker towards the tip, with narrow pale tips; throat white; breast and flanks washed orange-rufous, belly whitish. Bill strong, hooked, black. Dark eye. Dark grey legs.
art.pose: perched on a branch, side view
art.scene: leafy tree branches in central or southern Korea in spring, a twig nest nearby; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched upright: rufous-chestnut crown, narrow white supercilium, black mask, blue-grey back, black wings with a white primary patch, white throat, orange-rufous flanks, long dark tail, hooked black bill

adult female, side view perched: rufous-brown crown and brown back, dark brown mask narrower than the male's, buff supercilium, buff-rufous breast and flanks densely marked with fine dark scaly bars, no white wing patch
adult male in flight seen from above, body level: black wings with a conspicuous white primary patch, grey back, long dark tail
art.build: Medium-small, large-headed shrike, about 20cm, a little smaller than a Brown-eared Bulbul; big rounded head, stout body, long graduated tail often swung or flicked. Bill short, thick, with a sharp hook at the tip. Legs medium length, dark grey. Short primary projection: at rest the wingtips reach only the base of the tail. Perches upright on exposed tops of bushes and branches. In flight the white primary patch of males shows clearly on the black wing.
avoid: Do not paint a grey crown with a chestnut, black-barred back — that is Tiger Shrike (Lanius tigrinus).
Do not paint plain brown upperparts without a wing patch on the male (Brown Shrike, Lanius cristatus).
Do not paint a long, slender, unhooked bill.
Do not give the female the male's black mask or white wing patch.
